steps.label: root container listing with the ownership label column
steps.expect: zero exit; every object in the root container with its label column. The label is the ownership signal (ADR-0010 §4): an object at an expected name without this control plane's label is somebody else's, and an unlabelled object is DPL-born

steps.label: pool ceilings on the MC's own container
steps.expect: zero exit; the pooled-resource ceilings by type. Only dprc show (and its --resources variant) is legal against mc.global; this is the ceiling half of the fit check the compiled plan's feasibility sums are diffed against (design D12)
